'''2001 Atlanta DPC''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Decipher Player Championship in Atlanta, Georgia, on Saturday 28 July 2001. [[Clint Hays]] won it.<ref name="tr-myers-atl">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-29-atlanta-dpc-the-waffle-babyd2725/ atlanta-dpc-the-waffle-baby], Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, DeckTech (29 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-29-atlanta-dpc-the-waffle-babyd2725/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 28 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clint Hays]]

The date is the Saturday before Myers' 29 July 2001 report, which describes the event day as Saturday; the city comes from the report's title.<ref name="tr-myers-atl" /> The event was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal.<ref name="dt-18196" />

Clint Hays went undefeated in the Swiss rounds and beat Jim Boyd in the final for the $1,000 prize. Myers finished the Swiss 2nd at 12 points (+129), then lost a match to [[Brian Rippetoe]]; they "switched places", Rippetoe taking 2nd and Myers 3rd ($150). [[Steven Lewis]] finished 5th in the Swiss.<ref name="tr-myers-atl" /> Myers posted his Dark list as "the exact list" he played; it went 4–0.<ref name="dt-18196" /> [[Devon Clark]] went 4–0 with his Dark list and finished in the top 10; [[Brad Reinhold]] went 2–2 with his.<ref name="dt-18020" /><ref name="dt-18006" />
